_nota: Summary of the INIFAP 2026 Agricultural Technical Agenda, prepared from the text of data/inifap/extraido/morelos.json following pipeline/inifap/instrucciones_resumen.md. No pesticide brands or doses.
fuente: INIFAP. Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Morelos [Agricultural Technical Agenda of Morelos]. INIFAP, Mexico City, 2026.

fichas.region: East and northeast Morelos (Temoac, Jantetelco, Zacualpan de Amilpas, Tetela del Volcán): semi-warm to warm subhumid climate, 800 to 1,200 mm of rain, 1,400 to 2,200 m a.s.l., flat but poor and somewhat stony soils (Regosols, Vertisols). The midsummer drought (canícula) occurs in July and August.
fichas.densidad: 3 kg/ha of clean, new seed drilled or planted in clumps; with a planter, 500 g/ha is enough for about 125,000 plants/ha, with no need for thinning. In manual planting, thin to one plant every 10 cm.
fichas.fertilizacion: 40-40-20 at planting (200 kg of ammonium sulfate + 90 kg of triple calcium superphosphate + 33 kg of potassium chloride) and 40-00-00 at 30-40 days, at the first cultivation (200 kg of ammonium sulfate), to total 80-40-20. On acid soils use urea (87 kg/ha in each application) and apply it by hand, not with a planter. Fertilize with moist soil and cover the fertilizer.
fichas.malezas: Critical period: the first 30 days after sowing (golondrina, acahual, purslane). Remove them with a cultivation pass or by hand; new infestations, with another cultivation pass and hand weeding (tlamatecas). There are no selective broadleaf herbicides for amaranth.
fichas.cosecha: By hand when the lower leaves dry out, the upper ones turn yellow and the grain comes off easily when pressed or when the panicle is struck (grain with a 'fish eye'). Cut the panicles early in the morning, thresh and sun-dry the grain to about 11 % moisture. Expected yield: 2 t/ha.
cuidados: Do not plant where residual herbicides (such as those used on sorghum) were applied in the previous cycle: amaranth seedlings are very sensitive.
Plow to 25 cm and leave the soil well loosened so the seed ends up at the same depth.
Drain excess water quickly at the seedling stage to avoid damping-off.
Do the first hilling at 30 cm height (about 40 days) and the second ('cajón') before the rows close.
Watch for the webworm from 35 days, when the panicle begins to form, especially during the midsummer drought.
Store the grain dry and free of chaff.
fichas.nota: Two cost tables: the first is the manual system (Table 5) and the second the semi-mechanized one (printed as 'Table 2'). Price of 29 $/kg deduced from gross income / yield (58,000 / 2,000). In the semi-mechanized one the table gives a cost of 24,995 $/ha, net income 33,005 and B/C 2.32, but the sum of its items comes to about 32,959 $/ha (it includes the first and second hilling repeated): total cost, net income and B/C were left as null. It should be checked against the PDF. In the agenda, the storage section says 'do not store with less than 14 % moisture', which seems to be a typo (it should be 'more'); it was not included.

fichas.region: Dry tropics of the Balsas Depression, warm subhumid climate, about 900 mm of rain, calcareous soils. Grown by transplanting and under irrigation, in an upper part (1,000-1,400 m a.s.l.: Cuautla, Ayala, Yautepec, Emiliano Zapata, Jiutepec, Temixco, Cuernavaca) and a lower part (800-1,000 m a.s.l.: Zacatepec, Jojutla, Tlaquiltenango, Tlaltizapán, Puente de Ixtla and others).

siembra.texto: Seedbed: upper part from January 1 to March 25; lower part from February 1 to May 10. Transplanting 40-45 days after the seedbed in the upper part and 35-40 days in the lower part.

fichas.densidad: Seedbed of 200 m² with 150 g of seed per m² (30 kg/ha) to transplant one hectare; in the final field 1 or 2 seedlings every 25 cm, about 250,000 plants/ha.
fichas.fertilizacion: Seedbed: 40 g of ammonium sulfate + 15 g of triple superphosphate per m² before sowing and 40 g of ammonium sulfate per m² at 20 days. Final field with clean water: 120-45-45 at 25-30 days after transplanting and 60-00-00 at the start of the primordium (70-85 days in the upper part, 60-75 in the lower). With wastewater, reduce the nitrogen: 100-45-45 and then 50-00-00. Against chlorosis, ferrous sulfate at 50 kg/ha.
fichas.riego: Seedbed: light irrigation at sowing and then every 3 to 4 days. Final field: flooded basins at transplanting and a 10 cm water depth, irrigating every other day before the rains; total depth for the cycle of 1.7 m.
plagas: Stem borers (Rupela albinella, Diatraea spp., Eoreuma loftini)
fichas.malezas: Main weeds: cucharilla, hierba prieta, saucillo, clavillo, red grass, water grass, white-spike grass, foxtail, nutsedge, marsh onion grass and pelillo. Prevention with certified seed, clean implements and irrigation canals; manual weeding (tlamateca) at 25 days in the seedbed; clean the levees and surroundings one month before harvest.
fichas.cosecha: With grain at 22-25 % moisture, by hand or machine; then dry to 12-14 %. Expected paddy rice yield: 9 to 12 t/ha, average 10 t/ha.
cuidados: Use certified seed of resistant varieties and disinfect it before sowing.
Sample before deciding on borer control: inside the stem the larvae are barely controlled.
Remove or incorporate harvest residues and control weeds in and around the plot, which host pests.
Use pheromone traps (Diatraea borer) and sticky traps (fall armyworm).
Maintain the water depth and fertilize after removing the weeds.
Harvest at 22-25 % moisture and dry well to obtain more whole grain at the mill.
fichas.nota: Cycle is null: seedbed planting runs from January to May depending on the zone, and the text does not state the cycle. Price of 7 $/kg deduced from gross income / yield (70,000 / 10,000); the sum of the items in the table matches the total cost.

fichas.region: Humid tropics and dry tropics; optimum temperature of 16 to 25 °C and a water requirement of 1,200 to 1,500 mm per year. It adapts to clay and sandy soils; not to caliche soils.

siembra.texto: From August to January of the following year.

fichas.densidad: Single row at 1.30 m: 16 to 18 t of seed cane, about 42,000 plants/ha (manual harvest). Double row or 'piña' at 1.40-1.60 m with rows 30 cm apart: 20 to 25 t of seed cane, up to 72,000 plants/ha (mechanized harvest).
fichas.fertilizacion: According to soil analysis and expected yield. General formula 300-100-200 for 150 t/ha, in two applications, with ammonium sulfate or urea, diammonium phosphate and potassium chloride. Chemical-organic option: 10 to 20 t of organic fertilizer, filter cake or vermicompost plus half of the chemical fertilizer.
fichas.riego: Pre-planting (settling) irrigation at planting and constant moisture for even sprouting. The highest demand is from 1 to 6 months of age; irrigate every 30 days on clay soils and every 15 on sandy ones. Irrigate as soon as possible after harvest.
fichas.malezas: Keep the crop clean from planting until 4 or 5 months, when the canopy closes. Mechanical control with a cultivator and hilling, which also removes weeds.
fichas.cosecha: From 12 months (early varieties) to 18 months (late ones). Manual with burning and machete, or mechanical green harvest without burning. Average yield in Morelos: 94 t/ha; it can reach 250 t/ha.
cuidados: Subsoil to 60 cm on compacted soils and incorporate organic matter or harvest residues.
Level the land well and avoid waterlogging to prevent Fusarium wilt.
Use resistant varieties: this is the recommended control for smut and red stripe.
Against borers, remove host weeds, set pheromone traps and use entomopathogenic fungi if there are more than 20 dead hearts per hectare.
After harvest, cut back the stubble, do not burn the trash, irrigate and apply Trichoderma and entomopathogens to the soil.
Against field rats, conserve birds of prey with perches and keep the crop and its surroundings clean.
fichas.nota: Price of 1,250 $/t deduced from gross income / yield (117,500 / 94). The table gives a cost of 116,450 $/ha, net income 1,050 and B/C 1.009, but the sum of its items comes to about 155,610 $/ha (some cells do not add up, e.g. planting labor 1 × 22,000 = 20,000): total cost, net income and B/C were left as null. The table includes planting (seed cane and planting), and does not separate establishment and ratoon. Table 5 should be checked against the PDF.

fichas.region: Organic production under cover (greenhouse or shade net) in warm, semi-warm and temperate subhumid climates, up to 1,500 m a.s.l. Optimum temperature of 20 to 30 °C by day and 14 to 17 °C at night.

siembra.texto: The agenda gives no planting date. The tray seedbed lasts 25 to 30 days and is transplanted with 4 to 5 true leaves and about 15 cm in height.

fichas.densidad: Beds of 65 cm spaced 1.55 m apart, two rows of plants every 65 cm in a staggered arrangement and two stems per plant: 4 stems/m². It can be lowered to 2.5 stems/m² for larger fruit or under low light.
fichas.fertilizacion: According to soil analysis, discounting what the irrigation water supplies. Add compost or manure if organic matter is under 5 %. Feed by fertigation in three stages (transplanting to 40 days; from 41 days to the harvest of the first two clusters; until the final harvest), with a solution of pH 5.5 to 6.5; for the purely organic market, compost tea. Monitor the soil solution every month.
fichas.riego: Drip-tape irrigation on demand according to tensiometers: in stage I irrigate when it reads 0 to 20 kPa at 15 cm; in stages II and III, 20 to 30 kPa at 30 cm; stop when the one at 45 cm drops to 10 kPa. For the first two days after transplanting, water only.
fichas.cosecha: Starts about 75 days after transplanting; in indeterminate cultivars more than 10 pickings, about every 8 days. Expected yield: 158.6 t/ha.
cuidados: Check that the roof and sides of the greenhouse have no holes through which insects can enter, and keep the interior clean.
Analyze the soil and water at least three months before planting.
Use blue traps for thrips and remove wild plants around the greenhouse.
Start aphid control when there are on average 5 adults per growing point; use biological control (Beauveria, Metarhizium, Trichoderma, Bacillus).
Do not wet the foliage excessively and ventilate the greenhouse to prevent late blight.
Disinfect trays and pruning tools, and wash hands before handling healthy plants.
fichas.nota: Organic greenhouse production. INIFAP has not released tomato varieties; the cultivars it mentions (without a company) were put in hibridos_comerciales. The cost table in the extracted data is cut off (it ends at 'Maquinaria y equipo Motoas', 3,000 characters) and has no total cost, income or B/C: only the expected yield from the text is kept. Cycle is null: there is no planting date.

fichas.region: Warm climate, average temperature above 22 °C, below 600 m a.s.l. and slope under 4 %. Requires 900 to 1,200 mm of rain and relative humidity of 50 to 60 %; sandy-loam to clay-loam soils 1.20 m or more deep and pH near 6.5. Mainly in Coatlán del Río, Tlaquiltenango, Jojutla, Zacatepec, Puente de Ixtla, Tepalcingo, Tlaltizapán and Ayala.

siembra.texto: Plant once the rains are established (June), or at any time if irrigation is available.

variedades: Persian lime (certified bud) on Volkameriana rootstock (Citrus volkameriana)
fichas.densidad: Rectangular layout of 6 x 4 m, about 416 trees/ha, in planting holes of 50 x 50 x 50 cm.
fichas.fertilizacion: In orchards of 2 or more years: 1.2-0.6-0.6 kg of N-P-K per tree per year in three applications: August-September 0.4-0.6-0.6 kg (1.5 kg of ammonium sulfate + 1.3 kg of diammonium phosphate + 1.2 kg of potassium sulfate per tree); December-January and April-May 0.4 kg of N each (1.5 kg of ammonium sulfate). On limestone soils, micronutrients (iron, zinc, magnesium, manganese, sulfur) at 25 kg/ha together with the first application.
fichas.riego: Needed in the dry season from November to May. Irrigate at planting and 3 to 4 times in the first months. Young trees: 2 to 4 irrigations per week of 3 to 6 hours; adults: 1 to 2 per week of 6 to 10 hours (drip or sprinkler). About 100 L per tree per day.
fichas.malezas: Highest incidence in the rainy season (June to October): 2 to 3 harrowing passes between rows and brush clearing in the drip zone; in the dry season, two harrowing passes.
fichas.cosecha: From 105 to 120 days after fruit set: deep, bright green fruit, smooth skin and more than 42 % juice. Harvested all year, with 80 % from May to October. Cut by hand with a basket, before 11 in the morning or in the afternoon, and transport in crates of at most 28 kg in the shade. Average yield: more than 30 t/ha.
cuidados: Use grafted plants on Volkameriana at 60 cm height and a certified bud.
Do not plant where the water table rises to less than 1.5 m; keep irrigation water from touching the trunk.
Seal pruning cuts and wounds with Bordeaux paste or vinyl paint.
Formation pruning in the first four years, sanitation pruning in adults and fruiting pruning in August-September.
Protect shoots and flowers from anthracnose during the rains and watch for Diaphorina citri, the HLB vector.
To produce off-season (high prices from November to April), combine fruiting pruning, water stress and flowering induction in September-October.
fichas.nota: The sheet covers rainfed and irrigated conditions. Full-production cost (more than 5 years) from Table 1. Price of 22 $/kg deduced from gross income / yield (594,000 / 27,000). The table prints a B/C of 2.85, which is net income / cost; the B/C was calculated as gross income / total cost (3.85, a value that also appears in the table). The sum of the legible items gives 151,103 $/ha because some cells come without a cost (e.g. fertilizer application). The text on planting layout says 'Mexican lime', probably copied from another sheet.

fichas.ficha: Rainfed maize in the dry tropics region
fichas.region: Low or warm zone (700-1,400 m a.s.l.), warm subhumid climate with summer rains, 21 to 25 °C and 600 to 1,000 mm of rain; calcareous vertisol soils. Municipalities: Tepalcingo, Jonacatepec, Yautepec, Tlaquiltenango, Ayala, Miacatlán, Axochiapan, Jantetelco, Puente de Ixtla, Cuautla, Tlaltizapán, Amacuzac and others.

siembra.texto: From June 15 to July 5, with the rainy season already established. Start with late genotypes and finish with early ones.

fichas.densidad: Open-pollinated varieties: 25-30 kg/ha of certified seed; hybrids, according to spacing. Rows at 0.8 m with 5-6 seeds per meter, up to 75,000 plants/ha. On slopes, rows on the contour.
fichas.fertilizacion: According to soil analysis; in general 120-60-45. At planting 40-60-45 (36 kg of urea + 130.5 kg of diammonium phosphate + 75 kg of potassium chloride) and at 40-45 days or at canopy closure 80-00-00 (174 kg of urea), in the bottom of the furrow or in a band without touching the seed. On caliche soils, correct chlorosis with foliar ferrous sulfate (5 to 10 kg per 100 L of water).
fichas.malezas: Critical period: up to 45 days after sowing. In the traditional system, two cultivation passes (20-25 and 35-40 days); keep the area around the field clean.
fichas.cosecha: At commercial maturity, with 18-20 % moisture (about 140 days); sun-dry to 14 %. For mechanical harvest, near 14 %. Store the grain in clean sacks in a dry, ventilated place. Expected yield: 7.0 t/ha.
cuidados: Plant on the recommended date and with certified seed to avoid diseases.
Subsoil every 5 years or when there is a plow pan.
Control the fall armyworm during the first 45 days.
Prevent leafhoppers with biological control (Metarhizium anisopliae and Beauveria bassiana).
Keep the crop free of weeds for the first 45 days.
Split the fertilization into two applications, without the fertilizer touching the seed.
fichas.nota: Conservation tillage costs (Table 6), without sacks, rent, fuel or advisory services; guaranteed price of 7,000 $/t. The total cost is not printed: it was obtained from the sum of the items (34,753.89), which matches gross income − net income. Calculated B/C 1.41 (the table prints 1.40). In varieties, the materials with INIFAP nomenclature (H-, V-, VS-) were placed; the text does not give the company of the others. Those of doubtful classification (San Andrés, Zapata, Costeño Mejorado, Lucino, CRM, NB, NA-35, Amarillo CCC, Antílope, Sorento, Impacto) were placed in hibridos_comerciales: they should be reviewed. The asterisk in the table (yellow grain) was omitted.

fichas.ficha: Rainfed maize in the subhumid subtropics region
fichas.region: High or cold zone (1,400-2,000 m a.s.l.), subhumid subtropical climate with summer rains, 16 to 24 °C and 1,000 to 2,000 mm of rain. Municipalities: Yecapixtla, Ocuituco, Tepoztlán, Atlatlahucan, Totolapan, Temoac, Cuernavaca, Zacualpan de Amilpas, Tlayacapan and parts of Tlalnepantla, Hueyapan, Tetela del Volcán, Huitzilac and the upper parts of Cuautla, Jantetelco, Jonacatepec, Miacatlán, Temixco and Yautepec.

siembra.texto: From June 5 to 30, with the rainy season already established. Start with late genotypes and finish with early ones.

fichas.densidad: Open-pollinated varieties: 20-25 kg/ha of certified seed; hybrids, according to spacing. Rows at 0.8 m with 6-7 seeds per meter, up to 75,000 plants/ha. On slopes, rows on the contour.
fichas.fertilizacion: According to soil analysis; in general 160-60-45. At planting 80-60-45 (123 kg of urea + 130.5 kg of diammonium phosphate + 75 kg of potassium chloride + 142.5 kg of magnesium sulfate) and at 40-45 days or at canopy closure 80-00-00 (174 kg of urea), without touching the seed. On caliche soils, correct chlorosis with foliar ferrous sulfate.
fichas.malezas: Critical period: up to 45 days after sowing. In the traditional system, two cultivation passes (20-25 and 35-40 days); keep the area around the field clean.
fichas.cosecha: At commercial maturity, with 18-20 % moisture (about 170 days); sun-dry to 14 %. For mechanical harvest, near 14 %. Store the grain in clean sacks in a dry, ventilated place. Expected yield: 7.0 t/ha.
cuidados: Plant in June with the rainy season established and with certified seed.
Subsoil every 5 years or when there is a plow pan.
Control the fall armyworm during the first 45 days.
Prevent leafhoppers with biological control (Metarhizium anisopliae and Beauveria bassiana).
Keep the crop free of weeds for the first 45 days.
Split the fertilization into two applications, without the fertilizer touching the seed.
fichas.nota: Conservation tillage costs (Table 6), without sacks, rent, fuel or advisory services; guaranteed price of 7,000 $/t. The total cost is not printed: it was obtained from the sum of the items (36,392.29), which matches gross income − net income. Calculated B/C 1.35 (the table prints 1.34). The agenda copies texts from the dry tropics sheet: the planting date says 'low zone', Table 2 says 'dry tropics (low zone)' and the list of municipalities says 'low zone', although everything corresponds to the high zone. 'Local landrace' was put in varieties; the classification of Costeño mejorado, San Andrés and Lucino is doubtful (the text does not give the company).

fichas.region: Produced in greenhouse, plastic cover or shade net, between 1,200 and almost 2,000 m a.s.l. (Cuernavaca, Jiutepec, Tepoztlán, Emiliano Zapata, Yautepec, Cuautla). Optimum temperature of 23 to 26 °C; growth stops below 10 °C or above 30 °C. It needs 12 hours of darkness to color, which in Morelos happens naturally from September; relative humidity below 60 % in the reproductive stage.

siembra.texto: Mother plant: from January to February. The rooted cutting is received and potted from late April to early May (7 and 8 inch pots). Rooted cuttings: March 21 for 8 to 12 inch pots, May 20 for 7, July 20 for 6, and August 10 for 2.5 to 4 inches.

fichas.densidad: One rooted cutting per pot (3 to 4 in hanging baskets and large pots). In a 6 inch pot, 8 pots per m² spaced 35 x 35 cm.
fichas.fertilizacion: Through irrigation: 1 g/L of 15-5-25 alternated with calcium nitrate at the same dose and one clean-water irrigation per week; or Steiner solution at 80 % (cutting), 120 % (growth) and 80 % (flowering); or 1 g/L of starter formula and then 15-20-25 during development. Electrical conductivity below 2 mmhos/cm and pH of 5.5.
fichas.riego: Daily by drip (spaghetti tubes), or with a wand every other day with 240 to 300 ml per pot. From coloring onward, do not wet the bracts because they get stained.
fichas.cosecha: Ready for sale from the first week of November until December 15; it is protected with paper sleeves for transport.
cuidados: Buy the rooted cutting from recognized suppliers and order it months in advance.
Pinch according to the desired number of bracts; it is risky to pinch in the first week of September.
Avoid excess water in the substrate and use treated substrates (steam or solarization) against Fusarium; there are Trichoderma strains that control it.
Remove dead plant debris, space the pots and ventilate to lower humidity and avoid Botrytis.
Monitor whitefly and mites every week and act as soon as they appear.
Do not wet the bracts during coloring.
fichas.nota: INIFAP varieties are being licensed; those in use are commercial (the text does not give the company). Costs per plant in a 6 inch pot (Table 4), not per hectare: cost of 28.77 $/plant and 230.16 $/m², sale price 48 $/plant, gross income 384 $/m², net income 153.84 $/m². That is why costo_total_ha and ingreso_neto are null; the B/C (384 / 230.16 = 1.67) does not depend on the unit. Cycle PV deduced from the dates from April-May to November-December.

fichas.region: Northern Morelos (Tlalnepantla, Totolapan, Tlayacapan and Tepoztlán), between 1,500 and 2,100 m a.s.l.; temperate, semi-cold and semi-warm subhumid climates with summer rains, 8 to 20 °C and 1,200 to 1,500 mm of rain.

siembra.texto: Before the rainy season; in Morelos normally from February to April.

fichas.densidad: Traditional system: 10,000 to 30,000 cladodes/ha at 30-40 cm between pads. Microtunnel (frost-prone or low-water zones): 20,000 to 60,000 cladodes/ha. Bury two thirds of the cladode.
fichas.fertilizacion: 120-100-00 with 585 kg/ha of ammonium sulfate and 217 kg/ha of triple calcium superphosphate, plus 3.5 to 5 t/ha of compost. Many producers apply the organic fertilizer from February to May and the fertilizer in June.
fichas.riego: It is produced rainfed; during drought one supplemental irrigation by water truck at least once a month is recommended.
fichas.malezas: Manual control with day labor or chemical control. Main broadleaf weeds: rosa amarilla, wormseed goosefoot, purslane and chickweed. Keep the orchard clean, because weeds favor black spot and the weevil.
fichas.cosecha: All year, once or twice a week, when the first three rows of small leaves at the base of the shoot fall off. Cut with a sharp knife a few millimeters above the junction with the pad. High season from March to September and low season from October to February. Yield: 85 to 105 t/ha per year.
cuidados: Plow and harrow several times, leaving the soil exposed to the sun to reduce soil pests.
Inspect the pads for planting and discard those carrying cochineal.
General pruning in December; formation pruning in the first three years and rejuvenation pruning in orchards over 10 years old.
Walk the orchard often to detect black spot and the weevil; remove and burn or compost diseased cladodes.
Remove adult weevils by hand and cut damaged pads before the larvae reach the center of the plant.
Carry out pesticide residue and microbiological analyses to sell to commercial chains or export.
fichas.nota: The year 2 cost (production, 175,980 $/ha) was used; the year 1 cost with establishment is 317,180 $/ha (the sum of items matches). Price of 3,400 $/t deduced from gross income / yield (340,000 / 100); calculated B/C 1.93 (the table prints 1.9). In the extracted data, the statistics Table 1 says 'poinsettia' by mistake of the agenda; the sheet has two tables numbered 'Table 1'.

fichas.region: Dry tropics and subhumid subtropics, from 700 to 1,800 m a.s.l.: Amacuzac, Axochiapan, Ayala, Cuautla, Jojutla, Puente de Ixtla, Tepalcingo, Tlaltizapán, Tlaquiltenango, Yautepec and others, plus the mid-to-lower part of Atlatlahucan, Cuernavaca, Ocuituco, Tepoztlán, Tlayacapan, Yecapixtla and Zacualpan.

siembra.texto: From when the rainy season becomes regular until July 15; late hybrids first and early ones last.

fichas.densidad: 15 kg/ha of certified seed in rows at 75 cm, with minimum or conservation tillage. On rolling terrain, rows on the contour.
fichas.fertilizacion: According to soil analysis; if there is none, 120-46-00. With biofertilizers (inoculate the seed and reinforce at 20-30 days) it drops to 90-35-00. Soils with pH above 6.5: 98 kg of ammonium sulfate + 76 kg of triple superphosphate at planting and 342 kg of ammonium sulfate at canopy closure. pH below 6.5: 24 kg of CAN-27 + 76 kg of diammonium phosphate at planting and 259 kg of CAN-27 afterwards. On caliche soils, foliar ferrous sulfate against chlorosis.
fichas.malezas: Keep the crop clean especially during the first 40 days after sowing; if needed, hand weeding. Take care that wind-drifted herbicides do not damage neighboring broadleaf crops.
fichas.cosecha: From 120 to 150 days after sowing, with the grain almost dry (12 % moisture), when it cracks when bitten.
cuidados: Plant certified seed treated by the distributor against soil pests and sucking insects.
Watch for the sugarcane aphid at tillering and boot stage: act if there is honeydew on the lower third or many aphids per leaf.
Choose products that do not harm beneficial insects or bees.
Control the fall armyworm in the first 45 days; there are biological options (Bacillus thuringiensis, Beauveria, Metarhizium).
Use biofertilizers to reduce chemical fertilizer by 25 %.
Stick to the planting dates as a preventive measure against diseases.
fichas.nota: The agenda gives neither the gross income nor the price: the price of 4.8 $/kg was deduced from (total cost + net profit) / yield = 33,600 / 7,000; the printed B/C (1.30) matches. The yield of 7,000 kg/ha comes only from the table. Planting months: the text gives until July 15 from when the rainy season becomes regular; June was included as the probable start. The agenda names no diseases. The asterisk on KS 989 was omitted (the text does not explain it).
